A four-year-old boy fell into a sewer in outer Delhi’s Baprola area.
A four-year-old boy fell into a sewer in outer Delhi’s Baprola area, following which teams from the Delhi Police, fire brigade and the National Disaster Response Force have been deployed to rescue him, police said on November 12, 2026.
